description: Election Commission - W. D. Upul Kumara was elected as the member of the Hambantota Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Hambantota Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and the official declaration of a newly elected member to fill the vacancy. This content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
